normalization.algorithm: NFKD -> strip Unicode Mark -> lowercase -> non Letter/Number to spaces -> trim and collapse spaces

indexingRules.shardIdentity: Each city occurs at most once in each shard
indexingRules.shardKeys: Each folded city en/local/alias token: first two ASCII letters -> two-letter key; single initial ASCII letter -> one-letter key; Unicode Number -> d0; other -> u(codePoint % 32). Two-letter alphabetic keys cannot collide with Unicode u0-u31 keys.
indexingRules.singleLetterQueries: UI should show country/admin results and ask for a second ASCII letter before loading city shards; Chinese single-character searches remain supported.
indexingRules.chinese: Only the initial character of a whole source token creates a shard; no invented pinyin or aliases
indexingRules.stateContext: stateName and state.en are in searchText; admins foldAliases includes state name/en/source aliases
